thread:
toni: Heads-up — top-level p95 for /v1/answer is 140ms but drilling into route+client shows p95=410ms for client=mobile-us. Refresh didn't change it.

ash: Are the sample_counts different? small-slice tdigest merges often cause this.

toni: Top-card sample_count=29,100; mobile-us slice sample_count=470.

monica: Can you paste the quick db extract you ran?

toni: Quick dump:
```
select route, caller, sample_count, p50, p95, p99 from latency_rollups 
where route='/v1/answer' and ts between 1830009600 and 1830009960;
-- global all callers 29100 34 140 320
-- mobile-us 470 38 410 920
```

ash: That looks like a localized tail. Check routing events / quota logs around 1830009800. If fallback routed a subset to a CPU variant we get a concentrated spike.

metrics-bot: routing: fallback event detected tenant=acme_inc route=/v1/answer at=1830009827 reason=reserved_quota_exhausted fallback_target=cpu-approx-v1

monica: Product problem: on-callers glance at the top card and assume everything is healthy. We need explicit provenance and skew signals.

toni: UX ideas: (1) sample provenance badge on top-card that says e.g. "samples: 29.1k (from 12 slices)" with a link to drilldown, (2) per-card mini-heatmap showing top-5 slice p95 contributions so skew is visible at a glance, (3) tooltip: "Percentiles are from merged t-digests. Low-count slices can distort tails; click to inspect per-slice raw samples."

ash: Infra idea: when building derived dashboard comparatives, if a slice sample_count < THRESHOLD (proposed 1000) compute that slice's percentile from raw samples before merging to avoid tdigest low-count bias. File INFRA-4815.

monica: Short-term we can ship the badge + mini-heatmap + tooltip quickly. Long-term infra fallback to raw-samples. Also add chart annotations when routing fallback events occur so spikes line up with quota actions.

ui-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1201 (adds sample provenance badge + mini-heatmap + tooltip) — canary scheduled.

metrics-bot: INFRA ticket created: INFRA-4815 "raw-sample fallback for low-count slices when merging percentiles for dashboard comparatives". Suggested threshold=1000; will add unit tests comparing merged vs raw in low-count regimes.

toni: Action items:
- ash: review and land tooltip copy + runbook snippet (console#1201)
- monica: add chart annotation for routing fallback events
- metrics: own INFRA-4815 + tests
- toni: update runbook with example queries & checklist: check sample_count, inspect routing fallback timeline, review per-caller p99 contribution heatmap

Follow-up: regroup at 1830010200 to verify post-deploy behavior and close infra ticket if raw fallback not required immediately. :thumbsup:
